content.text:
The "Choose Pro" button on the highlighted plan is now green, using the same `--color-success` color (`#1a7f37`) as the success messages. The text stays white.

I added the rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`. It only targets the button inside `.plan-featured`, so primary buttons on other pages are unchanged. I also gave it a slightly darker green on hover, since the old hover color was the blue brand shade.

The visual tests flagged two changes: `pricing__desktop` and `pricing__phone`. Both are that one button and nothing else. I haven't approved the new baselines, because that's your call. If the green looks right, tell me and I'll approve them, or you can run `npx testivai approve --all`. I didn't run the functional tests, since this was only a color change.

STATUS: DONE
